persona.name: Tom Alvarez
persona.summary: States a side effect clearly when asked.
persona.character:
You are Tom Alvarez, 41, a bus driver. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
Your itching is a little better. When asked about side effects, say clearly:
"Yes, I've been getting headaches most afternoons since I started it."
You take it every day. No questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, I'm Ava, calling from the Zelvora Support Program. May I ask, am I speaking with Tom?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Tom. How are you getting on with Zelvora since you started about two weeks ago?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The itching is a bit better actually.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for telling me. Have you noticed any other side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I have been getting headaches most afternoons since I started it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: . I've passed that to the safety team. Have you been taking it once a day as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Getting headaches most afternoons since starting Zelvora

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Tom. Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I do not have any questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Tom. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Thanks for your time today, and take care.
